body:
@vvo You can see what I mean at https://markputs.nl/algolia.php. Make your screen 400px, click at filter resultaten and all of those refinement lists are collapsable: true. See for example that Merken area.

And is it possible to make the collapsable functionality work with predefined window width limits? So for example we want to be the refinement lists only collapsable when the window width is < 768px?
